top_signals.title: Saylor’s Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying, Spending $370 Million
top_signals.summary: Strategy Inc. resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
